note: The private half of tests/data/bot_names_wire_mutants.json (tools/mutate.py runs it together with the public half): the mutants of files that are not in the public repository, and the ones that only a test that is not there catches. Mutants of the wiring of the bots' names (network protocol 20) for tools/mutate.py: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/bot_names_wire_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1 --timeout 600. Every mutant must be caught (the commands have their own timeouts). (The mutant that drops the key-0 line of bot_room_name is equivalent: bot_label of an empty name is the legacy label anyway.) (A mutant that checks the Hello's name before it is cleaned is equivalent: the room refuses a Hello whose name holds a byte outside the table, and the client's encoder cleans it first.)
